statement: Let P be the set of unordered index pairs {i, j} with 0 <= i < j < len(nums). For each integer p, let k_p = |{ {i,j} in P : nums[i] * nums[j] = p }|. The function returns a result r such that r = 8 * Σ_p (k_p * (k_p - 1) / 2), where the sum is over all distinct values p that occur as nums[i]*nums[j] for some {i,j} in P.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^4; all elements of nums are pairwise distinct (i.e., for 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j]).

statement: Let a 4-element index set S = {i,j,k,l} with 0 <= i < j < k < l < len(nums) be called good if there exists a partition of S into two unordered pairs {a,b} and {c,d} (so {a,b,c,d} = {i,j,k,l}) such that nums[a]*nums[b] = nums[c]*nums[d]. The function returns a result r such that r = 8 * (number of good 4-element index sets).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^4; all elements of nums are pairwise distinct.

statement: The function returns a result r and r >= 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^4; all elements of nums are pairwise distinct.

statement: The function returns a result r and r is a multiple of 8 (i.e., there exists an integer q with r = 8*q).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^4; all elements of nums are pairwise distinct.

statement: The function returns a result r and r <= 8 * C(len(nums), 4), where C(n,4) = n*(n-1)*(n-2)*(n-3)/24 for n >= 4, and C(n,4) = 0 for n < 4.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^4; all elements of nums are pairwise distinct.

statement: If len(nums) < 4, then the function returns r = 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^4; all elements of nums are pairwise distinct.

statement: If len(nums) = 4, then the function returns r = 8 if there exists a partition of the four elements into two unordered pairs {a,b} and {c,d} such that a*b = c*d, and returns r = 0 otherwise.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^4; all elements of nums are pairwise distinct.

statement: If there exist indices i, j, k, l with 0 <= i < j < k < l < len(nums) such that nums[i]*nums[j] = nums[k]*nums[l], then the function returns r >= 8.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^4; all elements of nums are pairwise distinct.

statement: Let r1 be the result of tuple_same_product(nums1) and r2 be the result of tuple_same_product(nums2). Then r1 = r2.
preconditions: Both slices nums1 and nums2 satisfy: 1 <= len <= 1000; for every i, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^4; all elements pairwise distinct. Additionally, len(nums1) = len(nums2) and there exists a bijection π from {0,...,len(nums1)-1} to {0,...,len(nums2)-1} such that nums1[i] = nums2[π(i)] for all i (i.e., nums2 is a permutation of nums1).

statement: Let r = tuple_same_product(nums) and r' = tuple_same_product(nums'). Then r = r'.
preconditions: Let nums be a slice satisfying: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; for every i, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^4; all elements pairwise distinct. Let c be a positive integer such that the slice nums' defined by nums'[i] = c * nums[i] for all i also satisfies the same preconditions (in particular, 1 <= nums'[i] <= 10^4 and all elements pairwise distinct).

statement: The function returns a result r (i.e., it does not fail with an overflow, out-of-bounds, or panic).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^4; all elements of nums are pairwise distinct.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = 0 if and only if for every two disjoint unordered index pairs {i,j} and {k,l} (with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), 0 <= k < l < len(nums), and {i,j} ∩ {k,l} = ∅) we have nums[i]*nums[j] != nums[k]*nums[l].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^4; all elements of nums are pairwise distinct.
